rows.en:
{C:8190C202}{C:81958296FC0000000000}I've been waiting for you.
I'm one of the Dagwon. My name is
{C:819782830400}Rai Utsumi{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296FD0000000000}I've been waiting here
to guide you.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296082E00000000}Guide us?

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296FE0000000000}Yes. I've been waiting here
so you can meet up
with my senior teammates.

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296092E00000000}So, where are
these Dagwon?

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296FF0000000000}They're waiting at the {C:819782830300}teahouse{C:819782830000}.
I'll head to the teahouse first.
See you there!

{C:8190C302}{C:819582960A2E00000000}The teahouse... This isn't a trap, is it?

{C:8190C702}{C:819582960B2E00000000}Toya,
it's rude to say such things.

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296010100000000}You still suspect me?
Considering the situation,
I can understand that.

{C:81958296020100000000}But please understand
how serious it would be
if Arago took Natsumi away.

{C:81958296030100000000}I'll leave it up to you
whether you come to the teahouse.
I'll be going on ahead.


{C:8190B501}{C:819582960C2E00000000}I think I'll go.
What that Rai fellow said
has been bothering me, too.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296050100000000}We face an enemy called Grados,
and there's another behind the scenes...

{C:81958296060100000000}I can't stop wondering about it,
so I'm going with you, big bro.

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582960D2E00000000}We don't even need to think about it.
Right, everyone?

{C:8190AE02}{C:819582960E2E00000000}Right.
We're the ones who failed to protect Natsumi.
Of course we should go.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582960F2E00000000}Toma is right.
We should go, even if it's just us.

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296102E00000000}Then it's settled.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296112E00000000}So, are you people
going or not?

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296122E00000000}Toya,
don't you think
we should go, too?

{C:81958296132E00000000}Natsumi and the others...
I can't stop worrying about them.

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296142E00000000}You can't get a tiger's cub without entering its den...
All right, I'll go, too.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296152E00000000}That's our chief!





{x00}

{C:8190B402}{C:81958296172E00000000}We shall meet again someday
at Lord Arago's castle.
For now, I'll withdraw.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190C202}{C:81958296070100000000}Everyone, you came!!
Thank you!!

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296182E00000000}Wait, Rai!
I've heard what you have to say.
But whether we Dagwon agree is another matter.

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296192E00000000}I feel the same!
Hey, for once I agree with Kai.

{C:8190BF02}{C:819582961A2E00000000}Their ecosystems seem different, too.
Hmm, I'd love to study them.

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582961B2E00000000}We came because we trusted Rai.
Isn't that good enough?

{C:8190BE02}{C:819582961D2E00000000}Your failure is what got us
into this situation in the first place.
Do you understand that?

{C:8190C302}{C:819582961E2E00000000}Is that so?
I never thought
you were that pathetic.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582961F2E00000000}We won't make excuses.
That's exactly why we're so desperate.

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296202E00000000}I like that manly way
of facing up to it.

{C:8190C102}{C:81958296212E00000000}Uwoooooaaah!
I'm worried about
Natsumi and Mirai-chan!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296222E00000000}I can't fight with my body
like you all can,
but the enemy is immensely powerful.

{C:81958296232E00000000}That's exactly why I think
we should join forces.
Is that so wrong?

{C:8190C002}{C:81958296252E00000000}Right. Wouldn't it be best
to have them show us
just how strong they are?

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296262E00000000}You have a point.

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296282E00000000}Then let's do that.
We'll wait, so get ready.

{C:8190C102}{C:81958296292E00000000}We'll transform into Dagwon, too.
Thanks to Rai,
we can transform now.






{x00}

{C:8190C102}{C:819582962A2E00000000}We've won!!
That settles it.

{C:8190BC02}{C:819582962C2E00000000}Hold on, Geki.
Fighting them taught you something, didn't it?
They're desperate, too.

{C:8190BD02}{C:819582962D2E00000000}En is right.

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296080100000000}Then...!?

{C:8190BC02}{C:819582962F2E00000000}Let's fight together.
Now we know very well
what dependable allies you are!



{x00}

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296302E00000000}This settles it, right?
We're the ones who won.

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296312E00000000}It can't be helped...
We'll keep our promise.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296322E00000000}Can't we stop this now?
Our goal is to rescue Natsumi and the others
and defeat Arago.





{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296332E00000000}Now everyone Master told us about
has gathered, right?
So, what do we do now?

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296090100000000}Once everyone's gathered, 
{C:819782830300}Pentagona{C:819782830000} is where we're supposed to go.
That's what Master told me.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296342E00000000}Haaah...
How long are we going to be pushed around?
But we've got no choice but to go.

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296362E00000000}You're right.
I don't like being pushed around
by humans, either.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296372E00000000}If we go to Pentagona,
we might learn something else.
We've got more friends now. Let's keep trying.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296392E00000000}You're optimistic, Ryo.

{C:819582963A2E00000000}Sai Saici and I
may not be much help,
but we'll stay with you to the end.

{C:8190C302}{C:819582963C2E00000000}All right, next stop is Pentagona!
Let's give it our all!!



{x00}

{C:8193B102}{C:819582963F2E00000000}You bastards, are you really
satisfied with doing things this way!?
Stealing someone else's credit!!

{C:8193B302}{C:81958296402E00000000}What are you saying, Shuten?
We are Lord Arago's servants.

{C:8193B202}{C:81958296412E00000000}Even if he captured the girl himself,
that doesn't mean he can keep her
from Lord Arago forever.

{C:8193B402}{C:81958296422E00000000}You might say we're doing
Master Asia a favor.
What could be wrong with that?

{C:8193B102}{C:81958296432E00000000}But...

{C:8193B202}{C:81958296442E00000000}No matter how much you protest,
the girl is already at Lord Arago's castle.

{C:8193B302}{C:81958296452E00000000}It's about time we left, too.

{C:8193B102}{C:81958296462E00000000}It cannot be helped.



{x00}

who does this Master guy
think he is?

{C:81958296F93200000000}Ordering us around,
"Go here, go there"!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296FB3200000000}A simpleton like you

{C:8193C302}{C:81958296FC3200000000}Whaaat did you say!!

{C:8193C402}{C:81958296FE3200000000}Stop it, Toya.
This is no time to fight.

{C:8193C302}{C:81958296FF3200000000}Shut up, Kira!

{C:8193C402}{C:81958296003300000000}But, Toya!

{C:8193C302}{C:81958296013300000000}Are we supposed to let someone weaker than us

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296EC3700000000}That's going too far, Toya!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296043300000000}It's all right, Greyfus.
It's true that I'm weak.

{C:81958296053300000000}But without my teacher,
we wouldn't be in the position we are now.
Think about that carefully...





{x00}

{C:8193A802}{C:81958296593300000000}Rie... Nelfea...
Lun... They're so cuuute.

{C:819582965A3300000000}But then, Amm
and Mikoto are cute, too.

{C:8193A502}{C:819582965B3300000000}Teacher! Teacher!

{C:8193A802}{C:819582965C3300000000}Oh, what is it, Wataru?

{C:8193A502}{C:819582965D3300000000}Come on, everyone's watching.

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296E22C00000000}You're persistent, Crinn.
I have no intention
of joining Astante II!

{C:81930B02}{C:81958296E32C00000000}Why not!?
This is no time to act
on personal feelings, is it?

{C:81958296E42C00000000}There's a war engulfing
the entire world.

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296E52C00000000}Shut up!
I want to fight
Astante!

{C:81958296E62C00000000}Don't forget that I took you in
and say whatever you please!

{C:81930B02}{C:81958296E72C00000000}I'm saying this precisely
because I'm grateful to you.
You're such a capable man, and yet...

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296E82C00000000}Shut up!


{x00}

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296E92C00000000}Every last one of them...

{C:81909200}{C:81958296EA2C00000000}Every last one of them... what?

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296EB2C00000000}Oh, Mouar.
Are you going to say
the same thing as Crinn again?

{C:81909200}{C:81958296EC2C00000000}No, I won't say it again.
All I want
is to follow you.

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296ED2C00000000}Mouar...
All right. One more time.
We'll wait for them at Iron Castle and fight.

{C:81958296F02C00000000}If we lose,
we'll join them...

{C:81909200}{C:81958296F12C00000000}Are you sure, Jerid?


{C:81908F00}{C:81958296F22C00000000}At least as things stand,
I'm just a puppet of whoever
is behind Scirocco.

{C:81958296F42C00000000}I have no intention of knowingly
letting anyone use me as they please.

{C:81909200}{C:81958296F62C00000000}That's the Jerid I know!
Let's give it our best!




{x00}

I surrender to you.
{C:819782830300}Iron Castle{C:819782830000} is where I'd like you to land.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296FA2C00000000}I can't believe
Jerid would surrender.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB2C00000000}Come on, don't say that.
Let's hear him out.


{C:81908200}{C:81958296FC2C00000000}You're naive.

{C:81908700}{C:81958296FE2C00000000}Here comes Jerid.

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296FF2C00000000}I'm with the Titans. I'm {C:819782830400}Jerid Messa{C:819782830000}.
I surrender to your ship.

{C:81909200}{C:81958296002D00000000}I'm with the Titans. I'm {C:819782830400}Mouar Pharaoh.{C:819782830000}
I surrender as well.

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296012D00000000}What about the fellow with you?

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296022D00000000}Crinn isn't my subordinate.
He just happened to be aboard.
Don't treat him as a prisoner.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296032D00000000}Wait a moment.
We have no intention
of treating you as prisoners.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296042D00000000}We'd like you to fight alongside us.
Is that too much to ask?

{C:81908700}{C:81958296052D00000000}They've been our enemies all this time.
Are you sure about this!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296072D00000000}What's wrong with it?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296082D00000000}There's no point arguing, Emma.
This is how we've been
gaining allies all along.

{C:81909200}{C:81958296092D00000000}You mean you'll accept us?

{C:81930100}{C:819582960A2D00000000}Will you fight alongside us?
I think this has gone beyond
any one person or continent.

{C:81900B02}{C:819582960B2D00000000}I'll help.
Yes! Please let me help.

{C:81908F00}{C:819582960D2D00000000}I haven't thrown away
my pride as a Titan.

{C:819582960E2D00000000}So I'll cooperate with your group, AEUG and all,
only until this war
is over.

{C:819582960F2D00000000}If that's acceptable,
I'll help you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296102D00000000}What do you think, Captain Quattro?
And you, Kamille?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296122D00000000}The more strength we have, the better.
I have no reason to object.


{C:81908200}{C:81958296132D00000000}If that's what you all say,
I can't object.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296142D00000000}Thank you, Kamille.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296152D00000000}I'm looking forward to working with you,
Jerid, Mouar,
and Crinn.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296162D00000000}So he's grown up a little, too.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296172D00000000}What's the matter, Akatsuki?
You look pleased.

{C:81900900}{C:81958296ED0000000000}It's rare to see you
smiling these days, Kyo.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296182D00000000}I thought he was still just a child,
but this battle has shown me how he's grown.
I'm simply happy as his parent.


{C:81900A00}{C:81958296192D00000000}He used to be so tiny.
Now he's a full-fledged FT pilot.

{C:81900700}{C:819582961A2D00000000}It was worth pushing for it.

{C:81900600}{C:819582961B2D00000000}Yes.
But our opponent is Binzvanker.
We can't let our guard down.

{C:81900700}{C:819582961C2D00000000}That's true...


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930D01}{C:819582961D2D00000000}You're the one
helping Astante II, aren't you?

{C:8193D701}{C:819582961F2D00000000}Yes. And you are?

{C:81930D01}{C:81958296212D00000000}I'm Hilmocha.
My position is much like yours.

{C:8193D701}{C:81958296222D00000000}Oh, I've heard of you.
You back up
Jojo and the others, right?

{C:81930D01}{C:81958296252D00000000}Oh, you know quite a bit.

{C:81958296282D00000000}You've got your work cut out for you, too.
Providing backup
is the biggest headache of all.

{C:8193D701}{C:81958296292D00000000}True, but a war needs more than
just the people in the spotlight.
There's no getting around that, is there?

{C:819582962A2D00000000}Besides, there are people like you
who understand.

{C:81930D01}{C:819582962E2D00000000}Heh...
So we both have our share of troubles.

{C:8193D701}{C:819582962F2D00000000}That's right.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296302D00000000}Oh, Sally and Hilmocha.
What are you two doing here?

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296322D00000000}Oh, just...

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296342D00000000}We were just chatting.
What about you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296352D00000000}I like the view here,
so I came by
while I was in White Valley.

{C:81958296362D00000000}I wanted Lun to see it, too.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296372D00000000}Hello.

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296382D00000000}Hello.

Let's go, Hilmocha.

{C:81900D01}{C:819582963C2D00000000}Right.

we're not around, young man.

{C:81930100}{C:819582963D2D00000000}Hilmocha!!

{C:81935401}{C:81958296463300000000}What's the matter?

{C:8193C402}{C:81958296473300000000}He said I'm too kind
to be a warrior...

{C:81935401}{C:81958296483300000000}Toya is just worried about you.
Kind people get hurt easily.

{C:81958296493300000000}Even Toya, who worries about you,
is very kind himself.
You don't need to be ashamed of being kind.

{C:8193C402}{C:819582964A3300000000}But I...
I can't be like Toya.

{C:81935401}{C:819582964B3300000000}Don't get the wrong idea.
You have your own good qualities, Kira.
You don't need to become Toya.

{C:8193C402}{C:819582964C3300000000}Is that true?

{C:81935401}{C:819582964D3300000000}As a Brave continent hero, I guarantee it.
Have confidence in yourself, Kira.

{C:8193C402}{C:819582964E3300000000}Yes!
Thank you.

{C:81905F00}{C:81958296753700000000}I've been waiting for you!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296763700000000}You again.
I won't let you lay a hand on my friends.

{C:81905E00}{C:81958296773700000000}How dare you! Stand back!

{C:81905F00}{C:81958296783700000000}You're the one who should stand back, Antoon!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296793700000000}What's going on?

{C:81905F00}{C:819582967A3700000000}We've come to help you.
On orders from Posaydal.

{C:8190B501}{C:819582967B3700000000}Are you serious?

{C:81905F00}{C:819582967C3700000000}There's no choice.
Those are Posaydal's orders.

{C:81905D00}{C:819582967D3700000000}We have the same enemy to defeat.
Of course we should cooperate.

{C:81905F00}{C:819582967E3700000000}That's how it is.
You there, the fellow with the scar on his cheek,
I'm counting on you, too.

{C:8190B501}{C:819582967F3700000000}Right...





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81909B00}{C:819582968E3700000000}I never expected to find you
among the opposition, Haman Karn.

{C:81909E00}{C:819582968F3700000000}Scirocco.
What are you doing here?
Have you lost your place in the Titans?

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296903700000000}Me!?
You've taken to talking nonsense.
Have they poisoned your mind?

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296913700000000}Enough of this nonsense.
If you won't tell me
what you're doing, I'm leaving.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296923700000000}Haman,
we're about to leave...

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296933700000000}My escort is here, too.

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296943700000000}Don't be in such a hurry.
I was waiting here because
I thought I'd offer you my help.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296953700000000}You're going to help us?
I find that hard to believe.

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296963700000000}I've been observing the situation and realized
that Binzvanker is an obstacle
to the flow of history.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296983700000000}Those words...
I can trust them, right?

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296993700000000}Of course.
For now, I'll cooperate with you.

{C:81909E00}{C:819582969A3700000000}Don't put too much trust in him, boy.

{C:81930100}{C:819582969B3700000000}No, I will trust him.

{C:81909E00}{C:819582969C3700000000}Heh...
I thought you'd say that.
Do as you like.

{C:81909B00}{C:819582969D3700000000}Then I'll join you as well.





{x00}

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296A83700000000}Hello.
How are you doing?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A93700000000}I'm doing all right.
How about you, Sally?

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296AA3700000000}Well,

{C:81935102}{C:81958296740100000000}I'm so bored.
There's nothing to do without any sorties.

{C:8193CE01}{C:819582961B3400000000}Then do some maintenance.

{C:81932201}{C:819582961C3400000000}If you have a chance to rest,
you should take it.

{C:819582961D3400000000}We don't know when we'll have to sortie.
Once we do, we won't know
when we'll get another rest.

{C:81935102}{C:81958296750100000000}Yeah, but
Tap and the others aren't here,
so I've got no one to play with.

{C:8193CE01}{C:819582961E3400000000}I'm not playing.

{C:81935102}{C:81958296760100000000}You're a cold one.

{C:81932201}{C:819582961F3400000000}Are you thirsty?
I'll make some tea.

{C:81935102}{C:81958296770100000000}Oh, that's thoughtful of you.
Please do.

{C:8193CE01}{C:81958296203400000000}I'd like some, too.

{C:81932201}{C:81958296213400000000}Then I'll go make it.
Let's relax until our next sortie.

{C:8193BE02}{C:819582961E3300000000}Whoa, look at that.
The Cloud Sea stretches out before us.

{C:8193AE02}{C:819582961F3300000000}There are continents beyond it, too.
It's strange to think about.

{C:8193AA02}{C:81958296203300000000}Isn't it amazing that we,
who would never normally have met,
are here together like this?

{C:8193BF02}{C:81958296223300000000}It's also fascinating that
being separated by the Cloud Sea
has led to different forms of life.

{C:8193AE02}{C:81958296233300000000}Ha ha ha... He's an odd one.

{C:8193BE02}{C:81958296243300000000}It's fine, it's fine.
That's just how he is.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296253300000000}It feels like a brief moment of peace.
